policy: No invented floats. Score from warehouse pains + UOKiK + quoted independent repair PLN (fiveYearFix). Omit partsReality until Autodoc/IC stock samples exist; renormalize remaining weights.

campaigns.formula: max over UOKiK rows on chassis: base[severity] + min(0.25, vehicles_in_pl/200000); +0.05 per extra row; cap 0.85. No rows → 0.

fiveYearFix.formula: midpoint(headline.pln_independent) + sum(other_quoted.pln_independent[0]); null if no paid quotes; saturates at FIX_PLN_CAP 20000
